description: Adds a live preview pane next to the editor of a compose window.

functions.name: attachPane
functions.description: Builds the preview pane in the compose window. Resolves to false when the window layout is not recognised.

width.description: Initial pane width in CSS pixels.

render.description: Markdown is rendered when the message is sent.

preview.description: The preview pane is expanded (otherwise collapsed to a tab).

functions.name: setPreview
functions.description: Replaces the rendered HTML shown in the pane.

functions.name: setStatus
functions.description: Shows a one-line notice above the preview. An empty text hides it.

functions.name: setState
functions.description: Updates the render toggle label and expands or collapses the preview pane.

functions.name: htmlToText
functions.description: Converts an HTML fragment to plain text the way Thunderbird does for a plain-text body, without wrapping lines.

events.name: onEditorInput
events.description: Fired when the message body of a compose window changes, and when its editor document is replaced.

events.name: onUserAction
events.description: The user clicked a control in the pane: toggle-render, toggle-preview, hide-preview or show-preview.
